primary: I(H;E | C) at archive beta index 9, in nats per uniform archived-parent/anchor case in a uniformly randomized cubic frame. H is the exact four-category posterior draw of w3-b1-learned-s11; E contains six 5x5 face patches at Chebyshev radius 3; C is the full ORDERED vector of eight ternary 3x3x3 corners. The bound integrates out the stochastic H analytically.
matching: Sample exactly one uniform anchor per parent per panel, including rare corners; never search a configuration for a compatible site. To match a primary case, sample OTHER parents whose raw corner vector has the same cubic orbit, then orient their shell and visible patch to its exact ordered C. The number of aligning frames is the same for every member of this orbit (orbit-stabilizer); uniform alignment is consequently rejection-free and samples exactly the physical framed conditional law. For efficiency, use one uniform target frame per orbit, independent uniform canonicalizing frames per parent, and random cyclic neighbor lists. This changes dependence between cases but not a case's contrastive law. Each parent occurs only once within a case's candidate group.
bound: For K=1 use zero. Otherwise score log K + f(H,E_positive,C) - log(sum_j exp f(H,E_j,C)). Conditional on C and K, other shells are independent conditional draws from distinct iid parents, so the expectation is at most I(H;E | C=c). K is determined by availability and independent of shell/hidden outcomes at fixed C. Averaging all positive anchors (not equally weighted strata and not just matched cases) bounds the unconditional-in-C physical average. All comparisons are scores, not subtraction of lower bounds to infer a residual MI or a true-MI ranking.
comparators: Frozen affine seed 29 evaluated with its own equally trained critic; fixed two-corner A bits (exactly zero conditional MI, use exact zero critic); zero critic; uniformly permuted positive index within an exactly matched candidate set; an independently matched, unused parent's H paired with candidate shells where available (zero contribution otherwise). Fixed laboratory frame is measured separately without donor rotations; do not interpret a frame-randomized result as fixed-axis information without an isotropy assumption.
calibration: Plant a noisy H label from an actual archived shell face-center A indicator via binary symmetric channel epsilon=0.2. Separately tag archived shells with independent fair bits: known MI log(2)-h(0.2), exact finite-K oracle bound from Binomial(K-1,0.5), and ideal zero critic. This calibrates finite-negative and matching biases; no new physical sample, simulation or future label.
discovery: Existing parent split only. Fit critics and nuisance distributions only on training data; each of two critics uses one training half and an ordered-stratum nuisance prior estimated on the other, then average raw critic scores. Shared nuisance sources and frozen encoder mean the two fits are not independent replication. Rank rounds by the lower endpoint of the validation interval for the RAW nonlinear bound, earliest on ties. No test scores during discovery.
confirmation: Lock the best round in the completed prefix, before any evaluation on these test parents. Unchanged at beta indices 9 (primary), 8 (transfer), 0 (finite-archive negative control); use at least 64 panels. Score all anchors; report coverage, K histogram and independent parent blocks. Repeated sites/frames never increase the sample size for uncertainty. Approximate 98.333333% two-sided Student intervals on disjoint equally sized whole-parent block means, correcting the three primary campaign families. Gate: corrected beta-9 lower endpoint >0, beta-0 lower endpoint <=0, shuffled controls not positive, positive archived-shell plant, and 99.9% grouped MC-minus-enumeration interval including zero for fair bits. Nonpositive is inconclusive. Historical analyses on this archive preclude a claim of independent physical replication.
